task: LB-02D owner follow-up on bolts for actual 1.5-inch lumber

lowes.product: Hillman 3/8-in galvanized coarse-thread hex bolt, listed Grade A307

home_depot.product: Everbilt 3/8-in-16 galvanized hex bolt, listed Grade A307

prime_line_home_depot.product: Prime-Line 9059904 3/8-16 x 3-1/2 in hot-dip galvanized hex bolt, ASTM A307 Grade A

conditional_bolt_bending_yield.scope: 2024 AWC NDS Appendix I Table I1 bolt reference bending-yield value for later applicable NDS lateral-yield equations; not a Prime-Line lot certificate, bolt shaft shear rating, or whole-joint capacity

wood_design_reference.source: American Wood Council 2018 NDS Chapter 12 (historical design reference, not a current project approval)
wood_design_reference.summary: Structural hex-bolt design requires aligned clearance holes, washers or adequate metal plates at wood/head and wood/nut interfaces, and load-direction-specific wood edge, end, spacing, bearing, and group checks. A retail package's generic predrill instruction is not a structural joint design.

narrow_face_4d_screen.condition: Loaded-edge perpendicular-to-grain 4D screen if a bolt center is placed through the 1.5-inch narrow face of one preserved 2x6 member

wide_face_option: A bolt passing through the 38.1 mm thickness from the 139.7 mm broad face can have more in-plane edge room, but its exact factory connector hole positions, grain/load directions, wood resistance, washer and socket envelopes, and adjacent hardware remain unchecked.
reason_length_open: A purchased bolt needs an actual steel/wood/washer/nut grip, sufficient thread engagement, an acceptable unthreaded shank at shear planes where required, and a verified withdrawal path. The Prime-Line 3-1/2-inch product has a nominal standard-pattern 2-1/2-inch shank inferred from ASME geometry, potentially too long for a single 1.5-inch wood-plus-thin-angle stack; no delivered measurement or length selection is made. Retail length listings are availability examples only.
disposition: A 3/8-inch A307 hex through-bolt with compatible nut and washers is common retail hardware for a future applicable detail. It does not make A66 or another connector's unrated 1.5-inch wood joint safe or build-ready.
